procedure.method: Fresh independent editorial session with no spawning, resuming, forking, producer records or peer reviews. Read the exact pinned packet, case, rubric, rules, recording addendum and README; verified declared file hashes/bytes. Actually opened and visually inspected every poster using tools.view_image(detail="original") and emitted the returned image at original detail: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. First raw readings were then recorded from the visible images, retaining the M1/M3 title wraps. No copy revisit was needed. PNG headers independently confirmed 1672×941 natives, 720×405 usage views and 320×180 thumbnails, all RGB without alpha. Native ratio uses the predeclared height-edge half-pixel rounding rule; reduced views are exact 16:9. The adapter invocation follows the exclusive completed raw write in this same session. No tool event ID or session identity is invented.
